content:
One of the hidden costs when changing phones is having to buy a new case if the size changes.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, this seems like an unavoidable expense, but two accessory manufacturers don't see it that way—one of them is betting heavily on this claim…

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case already on sale at Best Buy, noting that it's compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging reads in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself isn't entirely convinced, commenting: "It seems a bit early to talk about this now." However, Matt Ronge of Astropad—a company that makes anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones—says his suppliers have told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker claimed that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but materials later leaked from iPhone suppliers also showed the iPhone 18 Pro would be two millimetres thicker than the previous generation.

If true, this would continue the existing trend, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than the previous generation.

However, not all leakers agree—some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide case manufacturers with dimensional information in advance so third-party cases can go on sale alongside new iPhones. But on the other hand, accessory manufacturers sometimes place orders based purely on rumours, and end up being wrong. Personally, I wait until the new iPhone is actually released before pre-ordering a case.
